scope: Local WordPress/MariaDB regression tests including REST dispatch. No new coverage, complete quality-ci, browser rerun or remote deployment.
behaviors_verified: Ambiguous headers and differing row widths return HTTP 400 before changing attendance, completion status or import history
Impossible ISO dates/times and offsets stay in manual review with no invented seconds or attendance percentage
Invalid durations, including numeric overflow, cannot become valid zero attendance
Invalid evidence does not hide a later valid row for the same email
UTF-8 BOM, uppercase accented headers, empty preamble lines, quoted names, decimal minutes, comma/semicolon/tab delimiters and valid time offsets remain supported
English validation reports the offending CSV row
Manual corrections, stale preview tokens, reconnection union and transactional import rollback remain covered by regression tests

cleanup.verified_with: Local read-only CLI counts for the owned fixture prefix and event title

deployment.reason: Plugin installation is performed by the environment administrator at the user request
